text:
marco: Heads-up: planning to publish SDKs (py + ts) in 30m change window. Release: 1.12.0. CI green but PyPI upload failing with twine 401.

deploy-bot: registry-check: npm registry reachable. pypi auth check FAILED (401). more details in CI logs: https://ci.internal/1234

jen: omg 401 from twine? did credentials rotate? @devex-oncall can you check KMS secret for pypi? :eyes:

simon: npm got published earlier in the pipeline: redwood-sdk-js@1.12.0 (dist-tag: latest). There's a small serialization bug in js client that breaks streaming. I recommend not unpublishing but moving tag to 1.11.3 and republishing patch 1.12.1 with fix.

jen: agree. For PyPI we should avoid new release until auth is fixed. Workaround: publish rc to testpypi or upload 1.12.0rc1 once we can.

devex-oncall: I'm looking at KMS rotation logs — seems token for pypi/uploader-service expired last night. I'll rotate and try twine upload to testpypi in ~10m.

marco: decision: roll back npm 'latest' tag to 1.11.3, publish 1.12.1->dist-tag next while we validate. Also add a deprecation note for legacy sync API in release notes to avoid surprise.

simon: commands:
```
# move latest back
npm dist-tag add redwood-sdk-js@1.11.3 latest
# publish fix as next
npm publish --tag next
npm dist-tag add redwood-sdk-js@1.12.1 next
```

jen: for python, once token rotated we should upload to testpypi first:
```
python -m build
twine upload --repository testpypi dist/*
# if good
twine upload dist/*
```

devex-oncall: rotated and tested to testpypi - upload succeeded. I'll coordinate a quick canary: publish js patch to next and update examples to pin to 1.11.3 for 'latest'.

marco: I'll update release notes and changelog with deprecation blurb for legacy sync and add canary instructions. Assignments: simon -> npm dist-tag ops; devex-oncall -> pypi token + twine upload; jen -> update docs/examples pinning. Check back in 20m. :thumbsup:
